pr_title: sql: validate function leakproof volatility at builder level.
pr_body:
Fixes: #97427

Previously, in declarative schema, we count on descriptor self validation to error out on invalid function volatility with leakproof flag as true. This is bad because descriptor validation panics at execution time which error out with a whole big print of the plan. This commit add such validation in the builder level to avoid such user unreadable error.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/97778)
I was saying that this should have a pgcode, and it should not come from validation code.

Sorry I misunderstood. I think I addressed your comments.
